liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **New Speedway Boogie** (2 reviews): The listener describes the performance of this song as pretty dank; New Speedway and Good Lovin' are cited as among their best ever versions [2][11]
- **Easy Wind** (1 review): Phil drives the performance hard, making it a favorite for the listener [2]

## The recordings

- **gd70-06-13.sbd.hanno.9079.sbefail.shnf** (recommended): matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 14 songs; 119 min; rated 3.2/5 by 20 [1]. Said about its sound: The reviewer states the sound quality of the recording is awful; The reviewer rates the sound quality of the recording as B; Drums are described as tap in the background, with an ugly overall mix [3][4][5][7][10][12][13]

## Around the show

- The deadbase notes a Nobody's Jam tucked into the New Speedway section [4]
- The audience is described as very enthusiastic, clearly enjoying the Dead's performance [11]
- Gary Duncan and Dino Valenti appear on the marked songs [1]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd70-06-13.sbd.hanno.9079.sbefail.shnf**: transferred by Hanno Bunjes, Paul Bottiglio and Uli T.; source: Soundboard [1]
